data.name: Agape
data.gender_notes: Agape is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Christian theology, Agape is the unselfish and divine love of God for humanity and the love of one person for another. The name Agape carries the meaning “Love, Charity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Agape usually hope their child will grow to embody love, charity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Agape belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love, Charity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Agape total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Agape" is derived from the new testament Greek word ágape, meaning a charitable love towards others irrespective of their deserts. In ancient Christian communities, the term was used to define the Christian love doctrine and the common practice of exchanging the agape symbol, which was often represented by the Greek letter 'Α' or heart shapes. Agape was believed to be a powerful force that bound communities together, transcending social, political, and even doctrinal differences.
data.spiritual_significance: Agape is considered a transformative force in Christian spirituality. It goes beyond romantic or familial love and represents an all-encompassing, selfless, and divine love. believers were encouraged to cultivate and practice this love towards others, regardless of their actions, for the sake of their own spiritual growth. Agape emanates from God's love for humanity, and it is believed that the practice of this kind of love helps believers develop a deeper connection to the divine and ultimately, a more loving and harmonious community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Agape carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Biblical tradition. The meaning "Love, Charity" symbolizes In Christian theology, Agape is the unselfish and divine love of God for humanity and the love of one person for another.. In Christian spirituality, bearing the name Agape serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual calling and connection to Christian values of love, charity.

biblical_reference.note: Agape is mentioned several times in the New Testament as the highest form of love, selfless, divine love.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Agape from London, United Kingdom embodies the meaning of Agape - "Love, Charity". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
